prior_block:
PRICE PRIORS for recurring line types (statistical model fitted on the thresholds t revealed
in earlier games; gross amounts). How to use them:
- The amounts are final thresholds as they were revealed: they already contain whatever
  deductible, VAT and customary-price judgement applied in those cases, and they were computed
  from the full invoiced quantity (the whole quantity was indemnified there). For an
  indemnified line of this type take the stated amount for the line as t as it stands and give
  a price_log_sd that matches the stated range. Do not deduct a deductible from it and do not
  cut the invoiced quantity.
- Deviate only for something this case has and those cases did not: an aggregate cap or
  sub-limit that the lines of this invoice must share, a percentage reduction for a breached
  duty, or a purchase price or sum insured stated in the claim that limits the line.
- Whether a line is indemnified in THIS case is decided by the policy and the claim, not by
  the history. The history only says how often this line type was paid at all. A line type
  that was never indemnified before is usually an ancillary charge the policies do not carry;
  treat it as indemnified only if this policy clearly says so.
- line 1 "Filling valve (internal frost-burst fitting)": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per pc about 52 (80% range 38 to 79); revealed per pc: 48-55 (case 16)
- line 2 "Connection hose": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per pc about 30 (80% range 22 to 45); revealed per pc: 27-33 (case 16)
- line 3 "Senior installer hours": indemnified in the one earlier case; when indemnified t per hr about 97 (80% range 69 to 131); revealed per hr: >=91 (case 16), so this line (3 hr) about 290 (208 to 393)
- line 5 "Vehicle costs": indemnified in 7 of 16 earlier cases, t = 0 in 9; when indemnified t per pc about 77 (80% range 65 to 88); revealed per pc: >=60 (case 16), >=68 (case 18), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), >=76 (case 21), 34-45 (case 23)

items.rationale: Sections 2.4.4 and 7.1.9 cover like-for-like renewal of the fractured valve; one valve at the reference price is €52 gross.
Section 7.1.9 covers connection elements that must be renewed with the fractured valve; one hose is €30 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(f) and 7.1.9 cover the necessary repair labour; the three-hour reference threshold is €290 gross.
Sections 7.1.7(e) and 7.1.9 cover consumables actually used in the repair, but §3.6(c) excludes the contractor's own small equipment. Allow €10 gross for ordinary repair consumables.
Sections 7.1.9 and 7.1.11 cover one attendance for the insured fitting repair; the gross reference threshold is €77.
Sections 2.4.6 and 5.2.2 expressly cover imaging used to locate the internal escape. A €50 gross equipment allowance is well within the €2,500 aggregate leak-location cap.
No external-frost endorsement is shown, and no escaped water reached the facade. Sections 2.6.4 and 3.5(a) exclude the line in full.
Section 3.5(b) excludes removal of render loosened by uninsured outdoor frost; no part of the line is payable.
Section 3.5(b) excludes substrate reinstatement for uninsured exterior frost damage; there is no payable share.
Sections 3.5 and 7.1.10 exclude the entire upgrade because the underlying facade damage is uninsured; even the like-for-like cost is not payable.
Section 3.5(b) excludes preparation and re-forming of the substrate beneath the uninsured facade damage; no share is payable.
Section 3.5(b) excludes finish coats on the uninsured facade regardless of the number applied; all four coats are excluded.
Sections 7.1.5 and 7.1.6 exclude repainting separate undamaged elevations for uniform appearance, so none of the lump sum is payable.
Section 3.5(b) expressly excludes priming associated with uninsured exterior frost work; the full line is excluded.
Sections 3.5(c) and 7.1.11 exclude labour attached to uninsured facade work; none of the five hours is payable.
Sections 3.5(c) and 7.1.12 exclude lump sums for uninsured facade work, and §9.6 provides no basis to allocate this charge to any covered work.
